title: Fix cart removal functionality

requirements.text: Debug and fix the removeFromCart backend function to ensure it properly removes products from the user's cart when called with a valid productId
acceptanceCriteria: The removeFromCart function successfully removes the specified product from the caller's cart
The cart data persists correctly after removal
The function handles edge cases (non-existent products, empty carts) gracefully

requirements.text: Verify and fix the useRemoveFromCart React Query mutation hook to ensure it correctly calls the backend removeFromCart function and properly invalidates the cart query cache on success
acceptanceCriteria: The mutation hook calls the backend removeFromCart function with the correct productId
On successful removal, the cart query is invalidated and refetched
Error states are handled and displayed to the user
The UI updates immediately to reflect the removed item

requirements.text: Ensure the Remove button in CartPage properly triggers the removeFromCart mutation with the correct product ID when clicked
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the Remove button calls the mutation with the correct productId
The button shows loading state during the mutation
Success feedback is provided to the user (toast notification or visual confirmation)
The cart updates to remove the item from the display

constraints: Do not modify the existing backend cart data structure
Maintain the existing useActor pattern for backend calls
Preserve the current cart query invalidation strategy
nonGoals: Adding undo functionality for removed items
Implementing batch removal of multiple items
Changing the visual design of the Remove button
